scene: Through the brass telescope, three strange rooftop sights fill your circular view.
picture: First-person circular view through the brass telescope lens with crosshairs. On the far left, a lush rooftop greenhouse glows emerald. In the centre floats a striped red zeppelin moored to a spindly metal spire. On the right, an illuminated golden clock face ticks with intricate exposed gears against the dusk sky.
shown: a sprawling green rooftop greenhouse with glowing plants on the far left
a striped zeppelin anchored to a tall radio mast in the centre
a massive glowing clocktower with swinging golden gears on the right
